pageSub: Who works in this shop and what each person can do.
title: People and access
sub: Invite people to sign in to this workspace. Each person uses their own login, so every action is theirs.

can.OWNER: Everything, including the payout account, roles and removing anyone.
can.MANAGER: Runs the shop: products, prices, stock, orders, promotions, settings and inviting staff. Not the payout account or roles.
can.STAFF: Day-to-day work: orders, the register, bookings and customers. Can't change settings, prices or the team.

removedDone: {name} can no longer sign in to this shop
inviteLead: They get an email link (valid 7 days) to sign in with their own account.
giveLoginLead: They get an email link to create their own sign-in. Their calendar, shifts and history stay the same.
name: Name
errAlready: This person is already on the team.
sentBody: {email} can now join with the link we emailed.
devLinkHint: Shown because email isn't set up in this environment. Send it privately: it lets the holder join your shop.

join.title: Join {shop}
join.lead: {name} invited {email} to work at this shop as {role}.
join.name: Your name
join.passwordHint: 8+ characters with upper and lower case, a number and a symbol.
join.existingHint: This email already has a VirtualBiz account. Enter its password to confirm it's you.
join.notFoundBody: Check the link in your email, or ask the shop for a new invite.
join.expiredBody: It has expired, was already used, or was withdrawn. Ask the shop for a new one.

readOnlySettings: Only the owner or a manager can change settings. Ask them if something needs to change.
ownerOnlyPayout: Only the shop owner can change where payouts go.
